packageRules.description: typescript-6 is an npm alias of typescript, so it is matched by its dependency name. It is the TypeScript that VS Code bundles, which the editor-types test checks against. It moves to 7 only when VS Code does.
The docs site pins vite to a patched 6.x under VitePress 1 (docs/package.json overrides); VitePress 1 is not tested on a newer major.
